item.title: Patriots’ Stefon Diggs helps fuel Super Bowl run with his fire on field
item.description: Diggs’ future was unclear after a season-ending knee injury derailed his one-year stay with the Texans, but the wide receiver has found a new stride in New England, becoming an emotional leader.

item.title: Trump’s environmental, small business chiefs visit Palisades, echo federal order to speed up permitting
item.description: The EPA's Lee Zeldin and SBA's Kelly Loeffler visited the Palisades, where they echoed the need for faster permitting facilitated by the federal government, amid pushback defending local control.

item.title: Sanctuary policies broke the system – but federal overreach won’t solve the problem
item.description: Interior immigration enforcement must be structured to balance federal authority with local legitimacy.

item.title: LA County agencies given chance to review Eaton fire after-action report, raising questions over draft edits
item.description: It was unclear whether county agencies proposed minor or major edits to the report. County Counsel said drafts of any documents, including the alert after-action report, will not be released, citing legal concerns.

item.title: Bass faces backlash over allegations she led ‘watering down’ of fire report
item.description: In response to the reports, real-estate developer Rick Caruso said was reconsidering a bid for mayor.

item.title: Editorial: LA County right to pause fraud-plagued settlement payments
item.description: Good intentions must not blind us to the plain fact that when there is so much money on the line, and so few guardrails, there will be opportunists who try to take advantage.

item.title: No. 2 UCLA women crush Rutgers for 16th straight win
item.description: Kiki Rice scored 17 points, Gabriela Jaquez adds 14 and the Bruins, who have a key game at Michigan this weekend, dominate another overmatched opponent, 86-46.

item.title: Sloppy Clippers buried by Cavaliers to begin post-Harden era
item.description: The Clippers’ 24 turnovers lead to 47 Cleveland points in a 124-91 loss, their first game since sending 11-time All-Star James Harden to the Cavaliers in a trade for Darius Garland.

item.title: 6 Turpin children to split $13.5 million lawsuit settlement over placement with abusive Riverside County foster parents
item.description: Riverside County will pay $2.25 million, while foster family agency ChildNet agreed to pay $11.25 million, the settlement agreement states.

item.title: Kings follow big acquisition with loss to Kraken
item.description: Andrei Kuzmenko scores two power-play goals on his 30th birthday, but the Kings can’t generate anything else in a 4-2 loss just hours after they added high-scoring winger Artemi Panarin in a trade with the Rangers.
